_comment: The course the courses end-to-end pass left on the QA test organization
(isTestAccount, test-mode payments). It is shared with the deployed course
checks, and safely: a course is sold per buyer, and the probe buys as its own
fixed address, so its enrollment is the only one it touches. Each run buys,
refunds (which ends its access) and the next run buys again on the same row.
`priceCents` / `currency` are asserted against the checkout's own answer, so a
re-priced course fails here rather than charging a different test amount.
